description.value: Rocky Point Ice Cream is a family-owned artisan ice cream brand that started as a seasonal scoop shack at Rocky Point Park in 1997 and now operates four Lower Mainland storefronts, including this one set within Coquitlam's Town Centre Park. All ice cream is made from scratch in BC's first licensed dairy plant dedicated exclusively to craft production, and the Coquitlam outpost offers outdoor seating in a park environment that suits a mid-ride stop well. The menu regularly features plant-based and lactose-free options alongside rotating seasonal flavours.
